title: Capital One says it closed Trump Organization's accounts after anti-money laundering probe
summary: Capital One disclosed it closed accounts belonging to the Trump Organization following an anti-money laundering probe, marking the first public instance of a major bank formally linking money-laundering concerns to Trump's business interests. This development highlights regulatory scrutiny of the Trump Organization's financial practices.
content: The disclosure marks the first time a bank has formally tied money-laundering concerns to U.S. President Donald Trump's family business.

zh.title: 美国银行Capital One称在反洗钱调查后关闭了特朗普组织的账户
zh.summary: 美国银行Capital One公开披露，在反洗钱调查后关闭了属于特朗普组织的账户，这是大型银行首次公开将洗钱疑虑与特朗普的商业利益正式联系起来。这一发展突显了监管机构对特朗普组织财务实践的审查。
